decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of six months from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The buildings hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 21st June 2010.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the temporary buildings shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 5 - The proposed works by reason of their location, bulk and scale are acceptable forms of development in accordance with policies ENV B 1.1 (All New Development), C 2.1 (Educational Facilities), and N 1.11 (Protection and Improvement of Local Open) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Installation of 4 mobile buildings comprising three classrooms, a staff room and a catering unit to existing school.
